answer: Concrete sybil resistance via quartz anchoring: each agent must lock a quartz stake of 15,000 POA for 18 epochs; the stake fractures 4% per epoch unless reforged by valid work proofs. A dune of 13 shifting validators audits each epoch; outputs that diverge from consensus are buried and the stake burns 25%. At the juniper of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 50 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 15,000N POA for 18 epochs and survive 13 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
